name: open-cursor-bridge
description: Codex + Antigravity + optional MiMo multi-agent coding bridge with execution receipts

openCursor.autoStartBridge.description: Start the local bridge automatically when Cursor finishes starting

openCursor.nodePath.description: Node.js executable used to start the managed bridge

openCursor.defaultAgent.description: Default agent routing mode. Auto is side-effect-aware; Autonomous explicitly enables auto-approved Gemini edits/commands.

openCursor.workspacePath.description: Workspace path for agent context; defaults to the first open workspace folder

openCursor.updateOnStartup.description: Check for Open-Cursor updates (git fetch) when Cursor starts and notify when newer commits exist.
